title: Decoration Power Use by Holiday Zone
dataSources: Decoration timers (`holidaytimer:event`), birthday spending (`birthday:spend`), and fireworks noise events (`fireworks:noise`).
app: Seasonal household telemetry from decoration timers, birthday spending trackers, and fireworks noise sensors sent to Splunk HEC via Home Assistant, budget exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=holidaytimer:event
| search kwh=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(kwh) as kwh by _time zone_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks decoration power use over time and breaks it out by zone.
value: Zone-level power use helps you decide which display is worth the visual payoff.
implementation: Send decoration power use events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of decoration power use by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It records how decoration power use changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
